turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Yes. Watch me do one first.
I sleep. Now "he". He is one person, so I add -s: He sleeps.
After he, she or it, the verb takes -s.
Right: She walks to work. Wrong: She walk to work.

Now try this one. Write the verb only:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
